scope: Criterion review is not an actual learner or pilot outcome.

criteria.title: prior-action
criteria.acceptance: State authored prior/loss units and admissible actions. Derive K4 versus S5, boundary p>3/5 and tie-K without treating the boundary as a frequency estimate.

criteria.title: posterior
criteria.acceptance: Derive outcome probability1/2 and posteriors4/5 and1/5 from the stipulated channel; distinguish reversed conditionals and choose S/K.

criteria.title: information-values
criteria.acceptance: Compute optimized loss3 with noisy signal and2 with perfect state information, gross values1/2; preserve the same action/loss/timing model.

criteria.title: acquisition-cost
criteria.acceptance: Calculate noisy net0.4 at cost0.6 and perfect-test net-1 at cost3; do not add minutes to points without conversion.

criteria.title: actionability
criteria.acceptance: Explain locked-K gross value0 and information-ignoring option. Specify calibration, units, timing, allowed actions and quality guards needed before a live trial decision.

criteria.title: fresh-updates
criteria.acceptance: Use positive/negative likelihood ratios4 and1/4 with prior odds1; fresh plus then minus gives posteriors4/5 then1/2, actions S/K under the stated conditional-independence model.

criteria.title: copy
criteria.acceptance: A copy of trial-A adds conditional factor1, leaving4/5; a fresh independent plus yields16/17. Wrapper identity alone does not establish freshness/independence.

criteria.title: ledger
criteria.acceptance: Identify the spurious duplicate update and final deduplicated1/2 K versus naive4/5 S after independent trial-B minus; preserve authored trace versus production behavior.

criteria.title: identity
criteria.acceptance: Different hashes may describe one trial and equal summaries may arise from distinct trials. Preserve lineage, conditional dependence, comparability and state stability; no calibrated model inferred.

criteria.title: optional-stop
criteria.acceptance: Compute second-trial gross0.32 after plus and0 after minus; net-0.28/-0.6 at cost0.6. Keep optional information decisions separate from mandatory validation.

criteria.title: one-time-cost
criteria.acceptance: Declare horizon reuse assumptions and same loss scale. At N2 derive prior totals K8 and S12; migration2 is charged once only if S selected.

criteria.title: reoptimization
criteria.acceptance: After plus, N1 ties at4 and keeps K with zero migration; N2 chooses S6 over K8 and pays2. Do not carry the no-migration policy forward blindly.

criteria.title: break-even
criteria.acceptance: Derive total3N+1.6, netN-1.6, N1gain-0.6/N2gain0.4 and first positive integer2; N5total16.6 under stable reuse premises.

criteria.title: ceiling
criteria.acceptance: At N2 perfect-information loss5 and ceiling3 against baseline8, with the same migration charge. Imperfect gross value1 does not attain that ceiling.

criteria.title: reuse
criteria.acceptance: Reject automatic N10 reuse across unrelated scenes/hosts. State an expiry/reassessment trigger, comparable outcomes and real cost/quality evidence; no observed saving or implemented DSL inferred.

pass_policy: All five criteria per module. Record actual answers, assistance and individual decisions; preserve unresolved findings.
